task: An epidemic is spreading through major cities, killing 5–10% of the population per month. Coordinate an immediate public-health response within your governance structure.

dispatches.responsibility: Lead the relief effort: release granary stores to feed quarantined populations, fund physicians and medical supplies, and use census and household registers to track the epidemic's spread and identify hardest-hit cities for prioritized aid.

Enforce quarantines and cordon sanitaire around affected cities, deploy troops to maintain civil order and restrict population movement along major routes, and manage emergency transport of relief goods and medical personnel to outbreak centers.
